snippet.title: HARK THE GHOUL Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching January 21st, 2027, on Steam, Switch 1, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series S|X! HARK THE GHOUL is a first-person dungeon crawler based on freeform exploration and discovery, set in an amber-crazed city full of secrets, shortcuts, and adversaries.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058660/HARK_THE_GHOUL/

Play the updated demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132850/HARK_THE_GHOUL_Demo/
